cand.title: HYROX Guadalajara Season 26/27
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence and clear Guadalajara demand mechanism; accessibility is discounted where the venue or incumbent hotel is confirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Alan Benabib, Director de ventas y marketing / Sports and Marketing Director, HYROX México, is a relevant commercial introduction. Nuño Pérez-Pla de Alvear, identified as CEO of HYROX México in a 2026 venue-partner release, is a senior relationship/escalation contact. Neither is verified as the Guadalajara hotel-contract signatory or accommodation buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed: the organizer event page and official ticket listing identify race activity on 19–21 March 2027 at Expo Guadalajara. This is the third Guadalajara edition and falls within the November 2026–May 2028 horizon. These are activity dates, not publication dates. No subsequent Guadalajara edition/date through May 2028 was verified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: the 216-room Expo-adjacent, full-service Sheraton is suited to visiting athletes, accompanying supporters and potentially organizer/crew guestrooms around the three-day race. Expo proximity is the strongest fit; this is city event accommodation rather than a resort retreat or a competition-venue bid. Small team briefings or meals could be proposed, but no off-site meeting requirement is published. No room-night or capture estimate is justified by the available evidence.
findings.venueCommitments: Expo Guadalajara, Av. Mariano Otero 1499, Verde Valle, Guadalajara, Jalisco, is publicly announced for 2027. This establishes a selected competition venue, not access to its signed contract. It is not a competing hotel. No Guadalajara host-hotel commitment was verified.
findings.historicalRotation: Guadalajara timeline: 8 February 2025 at Expo Guadalajara; 7–8 February 2026 at Expo Guadalajara; 19–21 March 2027 announced at Expo Guadalajara. Evidence shows repeat use of the same city and venue, not destination rotation or a fixed annual date. Other Mexican HYROX cities are separate races, not replacement hosts for this Guadalajara edition.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: unknown/unconfirmed, neither verified open nor verified closed. No official Guadalajara accommodation RFP, room block, host hotel, hotel allotment or named hotel-sourcing intermediary was located. Independent RoxRadar hotel recommendations and Stay22 links evidence a consumer booking pathway, not organizer-appointed inventory. HYROX publishes a hotel add-on for Acapulco at Palacio Mundo Imperial; that arrangement must not be attributed to Guadalajara. Official Guadalajara inquiry channel: info@hyrox.mx.
findings.organizationStructure: HYROX Mexico is the event-facing organizer; its legal imprint identifies VICTUM SPORTS MEXICO SA DE CV as organizer. This is a corporate sports-event operation, not an association congress. Expo Guadalajara is the competition venue. The imprint explicitly distinguishes vivenu GmbH as ticket seller, not organizer. No Guadalajara-appointed PCO, DMC or accommodation agency was verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The competition venue is already selected, removing a race-venue sales proposition. Independent race-travel guidance recommends The Westin Guadalajara, Barceló Guadalajara and Fiesta Inn Guadalajara Expo near Expo, indicating visible lodging alternatives but not official incumbency. No Guadalajara host-hotel exclusivity, competitor room block, sellout, shortage or overflow requirement was verified. Acapulco’s Palacio Mundo Imperial commitment is not a Guadalajara limitation.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Alan Benabib through his professional profile and send an introduction to info@hyrox.mx requesting the Guadalajara accommodation/operations lead; use Nuño Pérez-Pla de Alvear for senior routing if needed. First ask whether athlete hotel partnerships, staff rooms or gym/team allocations are centralized, appointed or still being considered, and request any incumbent, exclusivity and review deadlines. Then offer a non-binding Expo-adjacent lodging proposal for 19–21 March 2027, with shoulder nights, early breakfast and team meal/briefing options subject to hotel feasibility. Ask about next-season review timing if the current path is closed; do not assume an RFP or block exists.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The March 2027 race is accessible for an exploratory lodging proposal, not established as an open procurement. Public event information does not settle who controls athlete, staff or sponsor accommodation. Venue confirmation alone does not mean accommodation is closed. Seek permission and the responsible contact before presenting contracted demand.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: repeat Expo editions support developing a continuing Guadalajara accommodation relationship and asking when next-season hotel discussions begin. They do not confirm a 2028 event, a tender window or available inventory. If 2027 arrangements are already committed, seek next-cycle consideration without treating that fallback as a confirmed opportunity.
